verdict.rationale: Time logging is a fair question for a work-tracking product like Jira, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents native time logging (worklogs) against issues or projects. The only related item mentions Tempo Timesheets, a third-party Marketplace app, which is an external add-on rather than Jira's own capability. Capacity management and cycle-time tracking are adjacent features, not time logging, so none of this earns credit.
